papers.title: Joint estimation of quantile planes over arbitrary predictor spaces
papers.abstract: In spite of the recent surge of interest in quantile regression, joint estimation of linear quantile planes remains a great challenge in statistics and econometrics. We propose a novel parametrization that characterizes any collection of non-crossing quantile planes over arbitrarily shaped convex predictor domains in any dimension by means of unconstrained scalar, vector and function valued parameters. Statistical models based on this parametrization inherit a fast computation of the likelihood function, enabling penalized likelihood or Bayesian approaches to model fitting. We introduce a complete Bayesian methodology by using Gaussian process prior distributions on the function valued parameters and develop a robust and efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo parameter estimation. The resulting method is shown to offer posterior consistency under mild tail and regularity conditions. We present several illustrative examples where the new method is compared against existing approaches and is found to offer better accuracy, coverage and model fit.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注分位数平面估计的统计方法，与用户研究的FEA替代模型或生物力学优化方向无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification in engineering design, or biomechanics/implant applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维任意形状凸预测域上分位面不自交的联合估计问题
summary_zh.method: 提出用无约束标量、向量和函数参数刻画分位面，结合高斯过程先验进行贝叶斯推断
summary_zh.result: 新方法在精度、覆盖率和模型拟合上优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过理论证明和数值示例验证了后验相合性

summary_en.motivation: Joint estimation of non-crossing quantile planes over arbitrary convex predictor domains remains a challenge in statistics and econometrics.
summary_en.method: A novel parametrization uses unconstrained scalar, vector, and functional parameters to characterize quantile planes, with Gaussian process priors for Bayesian inference.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves better accuracy, coverage, and model fit compared to existing approaches.
summary_en.validation: Posterior consistency is established under mild conditions, and numerical examples illustrate performance.

papers.title: 3D-imaging of selective laser melting defects in a Co–Cr–Mo alloy by synchrotron radiation micro-CT
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Tsinghua University, 100084 Beijing, China

corresponding_authors.name: Zhijian Shen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials and Environmental Chemistry, Arrhenius Laboratory, Stockholm University, S-106 91 Stockholm, Sweden

corresponding_authors.name: Wei Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Tsinghua University, 100084 Beijing, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注选区激光熔化Co-Cr-Mo合金的缺陷三维成像，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡、力学测试或骨整合等核心方向。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or osseointegration reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用同步辐射显微CT对SLM钴铬钼合金缺陷进行三维表征。
summary_zh.method: 采用同步辐射显微CT对成型样品进行高分辨率成像与缺陷量化。
summary_zh.result: 成功可视化孔隙和裂纹等缺陷的三维分布与形貌。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微CT成像验证缺陷检测能力。

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the three-dimensional distribution of defects in selective laser melted Co-Cr-Mo alloy using synchrotron radiation micro-CT.
summary_en.method: Synchrotron radiation micro-CT was employed to image and quantify defects in as-built samples at high resolution.
summary_en.result: Defects such as pores and cracks were visualized in three dimensions with detailed morphology.
summary_en.validation: Validation was inherent to the imaging technique, demonstrating the capability of micro-CT for defect detection.

papers.title: Is the Anterior Approach Safe? Early Complication Rate Associated With 5090 Consecutive Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty Procedures Performed Using the Anterior Approach

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅报告临床手术入路的并发症率，未涉及任何髋关节植入物应力遮挡、微动或生物力学建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical complication study with no finite element analysis, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no implant-bone interface modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估前入路全髋置换术的早期并发症率
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析5090例连续前入路全髋置换术
summary_zh.result: 前入路术后并发症率在可接受范围内
summary_zh.validation: 大样本回顾性临床数据分析

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the early complication rate of the anterior approach in primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis of 5090 consecutive primary THA procedures performed using the anterior approach.
summary_en.result: The complication rate of the anterior approach is within acceptable limits.
